taskPrompt: For an Account update, list every automation that runs, the order it runs in, and every record each one writes or references.
startingPoint: Account object in Setup with source metadata only, before any deployment or execution.

expansionProfile.notes: Two co-phase before-save flows (undefined relative order) and a same-object re-entry write.

inclusionRationale: Robustness scenario: two active before-save flows whose relative order Salesforce does not define, plus an after-save flow that re-updates the triggering Account (re-entry), and a dynamic Lead SOQL, to exercise multiplicity, re-entry risk and unresolved handling.
notes: Account update robustness case: trigger before/after with a dependency class and a dynamic Lead SOQL; two before-save flows; one after-save flow re-updating Account; one validation rule.
